claim: The Dalles is a clear local-burden example: by 2024, roughly one-third of the city's water went to Google's three local data-centre sites.
comparisonContext: This is one of the clearest local examples for explaining why regional siting matters.
scopeNote: Local case study, not a generic proxy for all data-centre communities.
sourceTitle: As Google's Water Demands Grow, The Dalles Aims to Pull More from Mount Hood Forest
